title: Pontardawe RFC
short_description: Your Pontardawe RFC membership card, members' discount and club news.
full_description:
The official members' app of Pontardawe RFC, est. 1881.

Your membership card lives on your phone. Show the code at the bar and your members' discount is applied, every time, with no card to carry or lose.

• Your members' card: one tap to show the code at the till, with the screen turned up so it scans first time
• Members' discount on every visit
• See what you have spent, earned and saved
• Your membership at a glance: days left, what it includes and its history
• Club news, fixtures and offers, sent straight to your phone as notifications
• Dark or light, your photo on your card, and a quick welcome tour

On your Wear OS watch

• Your members' card on your wrist: open the app and show the QR code at the till, with no phone needed at the bar
• "My card" Tile: swipe from your watch face to see your points, and tap the Tile to open your card's QR code
• "Points" complication: add it to any watch face that supports complications to see your points balance at a glance, and tap it to open your card
The watch app works with the Pontardawe RFC phone app, which keeps your card, points and membership up to date on the watch.

Sign in with Google, your phone, a passkey, or your email address with a one-time code or a password. The app is for club members: if you are not a member yet, ask at the club.
release_notes: New look with the club crest, a welcome tour, and your photo cropped how you like it. Settings for dark or light mode, screen brightness on your card, and notifications. Your card on your Wear OS watch.
